name: codeforge
description: Practice competitive programming in your browser: JavaScript, Python, C, C++ and Java compiled and judged client-side with WebAssembly. No server, no sign-up.

paragraphs: Practice competitive programming in your browser. Write a solution in JavaScript, Python, C, C++ or Java, and CodeForge compiles it, runs it against every test case and gives a judge verdict, all on your own machine using WebAssembly. Admins publish their own problems, and every logged-in submission is saved to a progress dashboard. There is no backend server to run: the browser talks directly to a Postgres database whose security rules are enforced by the database itself.
features: 5 languages, all executed in the browser: JavaScript, Python 3, C, C++ and Java
Real judge verdicts: Accepted, Wrong Answer, Time Limit Exceeded, Memory Limit
Exceeded, Runtime Error and Compile Error, with runtime and memory per test case
Custom input: run your code on your own input and see exactly what it prints
Monaco editor (the editor used in VS Code), with drafts auto-saved per problem and language
